thesis: Monish Pabrai argues that while he initially focused on compounders, the dot-com bubble forced him to switch to deep value investing, a path he followed for nearly two decades despite missing the ideal window to return to great compounders in 2009-2012. He concludes that the best investment strategy is to buy great growing businesses at a price well below their value, noting that purchasing such businesses at 80 times earnings is typically not a great way to invest.
